Select approved drugs with the indication 'non-small cell lung carcinoma'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
